name: Radharc Árainn B&B

tagline.en: Geraldine’s B&B in An Spidéal, with views across Galway Bay to the Aran Islands and the beach a short walk away.
tagline.ga: B&B Geraldine sa Spidéal, le radharc trasna Chuan na Gaillimhe go hOileáin Árann agus an trá siúlóid ghearr uait.

mapQuery: Aran View Radharc Arainn B&B, Spiddal, Co. Galway
_whatsapp: Mobile in international format, e.g. 353861234567. Only add with the owner's OK.

en: Geraldine welcomes you to Radharc Árainn, which means “Aran View”: a family home in An Spidéal looking out across Galway Bay to the Aran Islands.
Mornings start with a full Irish breakfast, and Geraldine is always happy to help with dinner suggestions and local tips.
You’re a short walk from the beach, close to the Aran Islands ferry, and about 25 minutes from Galway city. Book direct here and pay your deposit securely by card.
ga: Cuireann Geraldine fáilte romhat go Radharc Árainn: teach teaghlaigh sa Spidéal a bhfuil radharc aige trasna Chuan na Gaillimhe go hOileáin Árann.
Tosaíonn an mhaidin le bricfeasta Éireannach iomlán, agus bíonn Geraldine i gcónaí sásta cabhrú le moltaí don dinnéar agus le heolas áitiúil.
Tá tú siúlóid ghearr ón trá, gar don bhád farantóireachta go hÁrainn, agus thart ar 25 nóiméad ó chathair na Gaillimhe. Cuir in áirithe go díreach anseo agus íoc d’éarlais go slán le cárta.
